# Orbit AI

> Orbit AI (orbitanswer.com) is a career suite for job seekers: interview practice and live interview help grounded in your own resume, a resume checker with an ATS score (Resume AI), and new jobs from companies' own careers pages matched to your resume (Jobs AI). One free account, no subscription. Web app in any modern browser, plus an app for Windows.

Orbit is used mostly by job seekers in India (freshers, campus placements, IT services roles) and by English-speaking job seekers worldwide. Prices are in Indian rupees (INR) in India and US dollars (USD) elsewhere, shown at https://orbitanswer.com/pricing. Nothing renews: plans run for a fixed time and are paid once, and credits never expire. A new account starts with free interview minutes and an AI credit.

Orbit is built for practice, and for interviews and calls where notes or AI help are allowed. Users should check the rules first.

Key facts:
- Interview copilot: during a live interview or call, Orbit hears the question and suggests an answer from the user's own resume, stories and notes. In the browser (Chrome and Edge can listen to a meeting tab) or in the Orbit app for Windows (beta), which can listen to any call app.
- Practice: mock interviews with an AI interviewer that asks out loud and scores the answers, an AI video interview, and a free interview warm-up that needs no account (orbitanswer.com/warmup).
- Resume AI: an ATS score out of 100, what's missing for the job you want, tailored copies per job, Word and PDF downloads. Editing, the score and downloads are free; AI rewrites use AI credits. It keeps the user's own numbers and never invents one.
- Jobs AI: new openings from companies' careers pages and job boards that allow it, matched to the resume, with a tracker and a few free AI fit checks a day. Apply always opens the original post.
- Also in the account: LinkedIn AI (score a LinkedIn profile against a target role), Code AI (coding-round practice with an interviewer's review), Offer AI (what an offer pays and how it compares, with a plan to ask for more) and Learning AI.
- Privacy: interview audio is transcribed as it streams and never stored; documents stay in the user's account and can be deleted at any time.

## Reading these pages as Markdown

The product pages and interview guides below are also served as plain Markdown: add `.md` to its address (the front page is https://orbitanswer.com/index.md), for example https://orbitanswer.com/resume-ai.md or https://orbitanswer.com/companies/tcs.md. A request with `Accept: text/markdown` to the page itself gets the same.

## Product pages

- [Orbit AI front page](https://orbitanswer.com/): all the tools, pricing (section "Pricing") and common questions (section "Questions people ask first")
- [Resume AI](https://orbitanswer.com/resume-ai): the ATS resume checker and builder
- [Jobs AI](https://orbitanswer.com/jobs): jobs matched to your resume, from companies' own careers pages
- [Interview copilot](https://orbitanswer.com/interview-copilot): live answers from your own resume, in interviews and calls where AI help is allowed
- [Mock interviews](https://orbitanswer.com/mock-interview): practice rounds with an AI interviewer, a video interview and a scorecard
- [LinkedIn AI](https://orbitanswer.com/linkedin-ai): a LinkedIn profile scored out of 100, the fixes to paste in, and a preview of how a recruiter search shows it
- [Pricing](https://orbitanswer.com/pricing): plans and credit packs, in Indian rupees and US dollars
- [Free interview warm-up](https://orbitanswer.com/warmup): practise common interview questions by speaking or typing, no account needed
- [How Orbit works](https://orbitanswer.com/technical): measured live-answer latency, the answer pipeline, and how the desktop app protects sign-in and data

## Interview guides

- [Company interview guides](https://orbitanswer.com/companies): how 100 employers interview (TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Accenture, Amazon, Google and more): the rounds, what interviewers listen for, and practice questions with what a good answer covers
- [Interview guides by role](https://orbitanswer.com/roles): what interviews for each kind of job usually test, from campus placements and software engineering to nursing and sales
- Each guide is at https://orbitanswer.com/companies/<company> or https://orbitanswer.com/roles/<role>, for example [TCS](https://orbitanswer.com/companies/tcs) or [Data analyst](https://orbitanswer.com/roles/data-analyst)
